script.setup: ctx.state.images=await Promise.all([0,1,2].map(i=>ctx.utils.loadTexture(`result-${i}.png`)));ctx.state.p=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,"#version 300 es\nprecision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;uniform vec2 u_resolution;void main(){float aspect=640.0/480.0;float view=u_resolution.x/u_resolution.y;vec2 q=(v_uv-0.5)*vec2(max(1.0,view/aspect),max(1.0,aspect/view))+0.5;if(any(lessThan(q,vec2(0)))||any(greaterThan(q,vec2(1)))){outColor=vec4(.055,.065,.08,1);return;}outColor=texture(u_image,q);}");
